sections.overview: The Asian pied starling is a black-and-white songbird native to South and Southeast Asia.
sections.identification: It has contrasting black and white plumage and bare orange skin around the eyes.
sections.habitat: It uses open farmland, wet fields, villages and urban areas.
sections.diet: It forages mainly on the ground for insects and other small food items.
sections.behavior: Outside the breeding period it often gathers in noisy flocks and may feed near grazing cattle.
sections.reproduction: Pairs build domed nests with a side entrance, often on trees or human structures.
sections.ecology: Some authorities place it in Gracupica as G. contra; older and other lists retain Sturnus contra.
sections.conservation: The cited IUCN assessment lists the species as Least Concern; it dates from 2016.
